title: Arkady and Rectangles
statementMd:
Arkady has got an infinite plane painted in color $0$. Then he draws $n$ rectangles filled with paint with sides parallel to the Cartesian coordinate axes, one after another. The color of the $i$-th rectangle is $i$ (rectangles are enumerated from $1$ to $n$ in the order he draws them). It is possible that new rectangles cover some of the previous ones completely or partially.

Count the number of different colors on the plane after Arkady draws all the rectangles.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $n$ ($1 \le n \le 100\,000$) — the number of rectangles.

The $i$-th of the next $n$ lines contains $4$ integers $x_1$, $y_1$, $x_2$ and $y_2$ ($-10^9 \le x_1 \lt x_2 \le 10^9$, $-10^9 \le y_1 \lt y_2 \le 10^9$) — the coordinates of corners of the $i$-th rectangle.

## Output

In the single line print the number of different colors in the plane, including color $0$.

## Note

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ba671b72d6655cf73930b8ac26d0064c6dc28bd3.png) That's how the plane looks in the first sample![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b84e29026ee49b5972ce2479ad7cb4e72b99e516.png) That's how the plane looks in the second sample$0$ = white, $1$ = cyan, $2$ = blue, $3$ = purple, $4$ = yellow, $5$ = red.
statementZhMd:
Arkady 有一张被涂成颜色 $0$ 的无限平面。然后，他依次绘制 $n$ 个边平行于笛卡尔坐标轴、内部填充颜色的矩形。第 $i$ 个矩形的颜色为 $i$（矩形按照绘制顺序从 $1$ 到 $n$ 编号）。新绘制的矩形可能会完全或部分覆盖之前绘制的矩形。

请计算 Arkady 绘制完所有矩形后，平面上出现的不同颜色数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 100\,000$）——矩形的数量。

接下来的 $n$ 行中，第 $i$ 行包含 $4$ 个整数 $x_1$、$y_1$、$x_2$ 和 $y_2$（$-10^9 \le x_1 \lt x_2 \le 10^9$，$-10^9 \le y_1 \lt y_2 \le 10^9$）——第 $i$ 个矩形的顶点坐标。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出平面上不同颜色的数量，包括颜色 $0$。

## 说明

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ba671b72d6655cf73930b8ac26d0064c6dc28bd3.png) 这是第一个样例中的平面![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b84e29026ee49b5972ce2479ad7cb4e72b99e516.png) 这是第二个样例中的平面$0$ = 白色，$1$ = 青色，$2$ = 蓝色，$3$ = 紫色，$4$ = 黄色，$5$ = 红色。
